_comment: Durable decisions Merlin must remember across runs, so it stops re-recommending settled questions as if freshly discovered. Each decision may 'supersede' candidate ids (removing them from the ranked pool) and/or 'explains' an integrity-flag / funnel-finding id (attached as a caveat instead of presented as a new problem). Dave (or a review session) edits this file; Merlin only reads it.

decisions.decision: The checked-but-unsent backlog is arithmetic and channel-blocked, not a quality leak or a fresh discovery.
decisions.rationale: Three verified, non-overlapping causes account for the whole 'checked' count, none of which is a funnel quality problem: (1) Checker was approving at up to 120/day against Pitcher's 30/day send cap — a 4x ratio guarantees a growing checked pile by construction; the daily_limit was reverted to 30 on 2026-07-19, removing the driver. (2) The large majority of checked leads are SMS-channel, which is fully blocked until Twilio A2P 10DLC clears — they cannot be sent regardless of backlog effort. (3) ~229 'checked' records in state.json have no brief file at all (orphaned state), so they need re-diagnosis, not pitching. As of 2026-07-19 there were 0 approved-and-unsent EMAIL leads. Do not re-recommend 'clear the backlog' as the single biggest revenue lever, and do not read the checked count as a quality leak.

decisions.decision: IMAP is enabled for dave@trevoadvisors.com. Stop recommending it.
decisions.rationale: Dave enabled IMAP in the Zoho Mail admin settings on 2026-07-27, and it was verified working the same day: a live ImapFlow connection to imap.zoho.com:993 authenticated and opened INBOX successfully, with imapflow and mailparser both installed. This is the class of change Merlin structurally cannot see — it reads repo state, and a vendor account setting leaves no trace in the repo, so repo-facts.js has no resolver that could ever detect it. Without this entry Merlin re-recommends it every night forever at score 18.0, crowding out real work in both the ranked backlog and Dave's own list. The same pattern applies to every other vendor-side unlock (Twilio A2P approval, Buffer tokens, Formspree): record a decision here rather than waiting for a resolver that cannot exist.

decisions.decision: DMARC aggregate reports for trevoadvisors.com reviewed across several report cycles (Zoho inbox, dave@trevoadvisors.com) and all show dkim=pass/spf=pass with no failures. The 'wait for clean report cycles' trigger condition for tightening DMARC to p=quarantine is satisfied. The DNS record itself has NOT been changed yet — still p=none as of this date. This is a manual OpenSRS DNS panel edit (no API access from this repo) — change the _dmarc.trevoadvisors.com TXT record from 'v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dave@trevoadvisors.com' to 'v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dave@trevoadvisors.com'.
decisions.rationale: Report review is vendor-inbox state Merlin cannot see or verify itself (same class as zoho-imap-enabled) — recording it here so a future session doesn't re-ask 'has anyone checked the reports yet' and instead goes straight to making the DNS edit. Do not mark this candidate fully superseded/done until the actual TXT record change is confirmed live.
